## Resolution: cannot reproduce. Closing on operator instruction (2026-11-19 PST)

The operator directed on 2026-11-19 that this bug be closed: it cannot be replicated, and the only remaining plan was to wait for the next live failure.

### Evidence
- The single failure was on 2026-11-04: `test_delete_permission_probe` reported "created issue REB-6995 never became index-visible", inside a full `-m live` run under load 25-40.
- 3 earlier timed rounds (REB-7248, REB-7249, REB-7250) were each visible on the first poll attempt.
- After Gerrit 3419 merged (`05c6414358f`), 20 sequential live probe runs in production Jira (REB-7252 through REB-7271) all passed, each in 5.8-8.9 s.
- Since `05c6414358f`, the visibility poll records the outcome of every search: `ok N hits` for index lag, and `error HTTP <code>: ...` or `error <ExcType>: ...` for a rejected search. The probe's assertion message lists every attempt. If the failure recurs, the next failing `-m live` run will identify the cause, and a new bug can start from that evidence.

### Cleanup re-checked on 2026-11-19 PST (the operator's 2026-11-17 condition)
- Jira, read-only via `acli`: `key = REB-<n>` returns "issue does not exist" for REB-6995, REB-1981, REB-7248, REB-7249, REB-7250, and REB-7252 through REB-7271. The control REB-7251 is returned normally. `summary ~ "rebar probe - safe to delete" OR summary ~ "DELETE-ME-d01e"` returns 0 rows.
- rebar: a title scan of all 6071 tickets, including archived ones, finds only `jira-reb-1936` (the REB-1981 copy), which is archived. `.bridge_state/bindings.json` on `origin/tickets` (`37033c41613`) has no binding for any probe key, and `prev_snapshot.json` goes from REB-7251 to REB-7272.

### Acceptance criteria
AC 1-5 were met, as recorded in the previous comment. AC 6 (the cause identified from a logged failing run and fixed) is NOT met, because no failure recurred. This close does not claim completion: it is a `wontfix` disposition, declining the remaining wait-for-recurrence work on operator instruction, and the box is left unticked.
